mode.title: Dataset Mode
mode.description: Choose consolidated candidate results, active election catalog, municipalities/zones, or geocoded polling stations.

cycle.title: Election Cycle
cycle.description: TSE cycle slug (e.g. ele2026 or ele2024).

electionId.title: TSE Election ID (cd_eleicao)
electionId.description: Official TSE election code (e.g. 6258 = 2026 President 2nd round, 6257 = 1st round, 6260 = 2026 Governor 2nd round).

scope.title: Geographic Scope (br or UF)
scope.description: Territory code: 'br' for Brazil total or 2-letter UF code (sp, rj, mg, al, pe, ba, df, etc.).

municipalityCode.title: TSE Municipality Code (5 digits, optional)
municipalityCode.description: Optional 5-digit TSE municipality code (e.g. 71072 for Sao Paulo, 27855 for Maceio).

query.title: Search Query (Candidate, Party, City, or School)
query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across candidate names, party acronyms, municipalities, or polling stations.
